# Source: original fixture

Authored for the trustabl test corpus. Synthetic files for MCP-215, MCP-216, MCP-217, MCP-219,
MCP-220, LC-204 and LC-205: a Python MCP server whose tools pass a parameter to a git
subprocess, a file path, `eval` and a mem0 scope key built by joining two parameters; a
TypeScript MCP server whose tools pass a parameter to `execSync` and `eval`; two LangChain tools
that put a parameter in a vector-store filter and in a store namespace; a test-path file with an
`eval` tool (not judged); and a `safe/` folder with the same tools written with an allowlist, a
resolved root, a cast and a single-identifier scope. No external code. Public-domain.
